results.title: My Heaven, Your Hell
results.overview: Over the years, Adela and Victoria live an impossible love story and are strongly punished by the law and by the society of the 60's and 70's in Spain. However, despite all the impediments, they cannot forget each other.

results.title: The Perpetual Journey to the Homeland
results.overview: Over 30 years of fieldwork, photographer Randa Shaath built an extensive archive of Palestine: decades of photographs of the people and places she calls home. In her living room, we open the archive together, guided by her rare gift for remembering a story behind each photo.  One more return to Albelad (the homeland), she glides through the photos, and with every return, a story surfaces. She holds onto a narrative in which hope was possible, and a free Palestine never felt far away.

results.title: Eric Johnson Live Madrid
results.overview: Guitar virtuoso Eric Johnson performed in Madrid on Sunday, July 5, 2026, as part of his "Texaphonic 2026" European tour. The highly anticipated concert, featuring Tal Bergman on drums and Daniel Kimbro on bass, was hosted at Sala Lab Wagon located in the Estación de Chamartín.

results.title: 5A
results.overview: A photographer becomes the subject of his own obsession when he realises that someone has turned the lens on him.

results.title: Well Being
results.overview: Short film written by Emir Kuliev, directed by Kevin McNally.

results.title: The Rules of the Game
results.overview: On the dark web where users bet on who will win, a talented chess player is kidnapped and thrown into a game where she is one of the pieces, and when your piece gets taken, you die.

results.title: Dua
results.overview: Prishtina, Kosova, late 1990s. As war looms and ethnic tensions escalate, 13-year-old Dua struggles to find her place among her peers and within her changing body. After an incident shakes her community, she becomes a target herself and bonds with a fearless girl, Maki, who draws her toward an unexpected form of resistance. Between the daily violence and the growing threat of exile, there is little room for quiet awakenings.

results.title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
results.original_title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
results.overview: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

results.title: Sorry, Charlie
results.overview: A remote helpline volunteer is targeted by "The Gentleman," a stranger who lures women from their homes with a recording of a crying baby.

results.title: The Caretaker
results.overview: A recently bereaved man takes up a caretaker position at an elite academy and soon uncovers dark secrets.

results.title: Chebi: My Fluffy Friend 2
results.overview: Cheburashka gradually gets used to life with Gena, but like any growing child, Cheburashka begins to show excessive independence, and sometimes even become a hooligan. They live happily until their peaceful life is disrupted by an incredible event. In the second part, not only the already beloved heroes will remain, but also new, unusual characters will appear.

results.title: Radio Sky
results.overview: When NASA loses contact with American astronauts in space, a notorious hacker - under house arrest for breaching top-level government agencies - watches the crisis unfold on the news. Acting on instinct, he illegally hacks into the Deep Space Network and gains access to the International Space Station. There, he discovers a single survivor: a first-time female astronaut, held hostage by a Russian billionaire who claims he has discovered alien life and insists NASA stole his proof. Confined to his cluttered bedroom and shackled by ankle monitors, the hacker is thrust into a deadly game. The Russian demands he break into NASA again to recover the evidence - or the girl dies. From his apartment, the hacker must guide her escape, uncover buried secrets, and evade government surveillance... or lose her forever.

results.title: De Club van Sinterklaas film: Paniek in het Pietendorp
results.original_title: De Club van Sinterklaas film: Paniek in het Pietendorp

results.title: The Town That Takes
results.overview: After his young son vanishes during a family road trip through a remote backwoods town, a desperate father joins forces with two detectives to uncover the terrifying truth behind the legend of CROATOAN. As the town's dark secrets unravel, they realize something ancient is hunting children.

results.title: Till We Meet Again on the Starry Hill
results.original_title: あの星が降る丘で、君とまた出会いたい。
results.overview: Yuri, a high school teacher, lives her busy days carrying a sacred "vow" in her heart: to fulfill the dream of the one she loved, Akira, who aspired to be a teacher but perished in the flames of war. One day, a temporary teacher named Ryo appears. Yuri finds herself constantly seeing traces of Akira in Ryo's casual gestures and words. Though confused by her wavering heart, she desperately tries to suppress her feelings for him, having resolved to love only Akira for the rest of her life.

results.title: I'll Be Gone in June
results.overview: In 2001, Franny, a 16-year-old exchange student from Germany, arrives in the sleepy desert town of Las Cruces, New Mexico. Far from home, Franny struggles through awkward school days, stifling heat, and restless nights until she meets Elliott, a boy whose quiet sadness mirrors her own. As America reels from 9/11, something resonates within Franny and an unexpected tenderness begins to bloom.

results.title: Living On
results.overview: Art therapy, para-archery and summiting peaks: life on the front line against an enemy five times larger.

results.title: When The Sun Burns Out
results.overview: Julia finds comfort in her high school teacher after losing her cat. This event triggers obsessions and fantasies that unsettle her for the first time. As the line between dreams and reality blurs, Julia must accept her pain to begin healing.

results.title: Beginners
results.overview: It's ten minutes before opening night. Tensions collide as a stressed stage manager scrambles to maintain order in an increasingly chaotic pre-show panic which threatens to derail the show (and everyone's mental sanity).
